registration.scope: single-node TP complete probe; two reductions+CUBE each repetition
registration.semantic_boundary: both arms use one fixed TreePlan; no claim of installed HCCL equivalence, isolated cold-call latency or decoder TPOT

measurement.unit: one captured graph containing K complete probes, divided by K
measurement.clock: same-host CLOCK_MONOTONIC; perf_counter and real-time anchors recorded
measurement.start: gloo agrees a future CLOCK_MONOTONIC deadline; actual submission envelope retained
measurement.outside: input change, CPU oracle, sentinel fill, pressure, NPU sync, gloo barrier
measurement.cache: 256 MiB or larger full read/write; first repetition is pressure-conditioned
measurement.warm_repetitions_fraction: (K-1)/K; this is not isolated cold-call latency

hypothesis.acceptance: every rows, both host/event; global p50/p95 and paired world p50; all numerical/rank-completion checks pass; >=30 world pairs
hypothesis.pilot: fewer worlds report raw statistics but cannot accept the hypothesis

launch.source_identity: registered actual source SHA256 and frozen compiled manifest

co_tenant_evidence: every world has hash-verified idle process tables before/after; this cannot observe a transient co-tenant between snapshots
